# Three.js

`three.min.js` is the unmodified UMD distribution of Three.js r160, vendored so
the 3D studio works without a build, network dependency, or module server.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/r160/build/three.min.js

License: `THREE-LICENSE.txt` (MIT). This is intentionally the classic script
distribution; newer module-only builds would change the direct-file workflow.
